title: Marcus Auraylius delivers his highly anticipated track, "CAT5"
htmlContent:
Marcus Auralyius, also known as Mave, is a multi-talented Hip-Hop singer, songwriter, and Producer based in America. Through his distinctive writing and emotion-filled Vocals, Mave delivers raw emotion through explosive instrumentation titled "CAT5". 

Marcus Auraylius "CAT5" is a high-energy hip-hop song with a Rage-style flow that will have you nodding your head along to the beat. His sound is daring and pays significant dividends for this genius-level production with vibes and instrumentation that can only come from a true master of their craft.
